name: waitloop
description: Developer-native waiting layer for coding agents with lifecycle hooks, tiny games, hosted AI players, and room-scoped MCP game actors.

cli.doctorBehavior: checks the published CLI version plus detected Codex version/hooks capability, installed lifecycle hook events, and stable local MCP configuration

rooms.seatIds: stable room-scoped seat-1/seat-2/seat-3 identifiers for the current three-seat game
rooms.controlModel: a Seat is the game player position; Actors bind to seats and only the active controller may play
rooms.browserIdentity: anonymous persistent Actor ID plus separate HttpOnly credential; no account required
rooms.recovery: a remembered browser Actor can recover room viewer access; a Seat owner may temporarily yield/replace control with a bot without changing Seat ownership

localMcp.controlPlane: create_room and join_room reuse the existing Room/Join HTTP APIs internally
localMcp.credentialHandling: room Actor credentials remain in private local cache and are never returned by local MCP tools
localMcp.activeRoom: waitloop join or join_room selects one credential-backed active room; the bridge can restart and resume it until room expiry
localMcp.createRoomScope: create_room currently creates the existing headless agent-bots Dou Dizhu mode

mcp.scope: one game room and one connected actor binding
mcp.joinBehavior: prefer local MCP join_room or CLI waitloop join; both claim/cache the credential and select an active room, while raw remote MCP remains an advanced fallback
mcp.waitBehavior: wait_for_turn is a bounded transport wait that returns on turn, finish, pause, lobby, controller change, or timeout; timeout never auto-passes or takes over
mcp.continuationBehavior: MCP does not wake an agent after it returns a final response; a request to play continuously must keep the current agent run active until the requested stopping condition
mcp.advisorBehavior: an advisor can inspect its bound seat and comment but play_move is rejected until the seat owner delegates control
mcp.reconnectBehavior: the cached room actor credential can reconnect while the room is active; reconnect never silently steals control from a temporary bot, so the owner calls take_control explicitly

codex.postInstall: Codex requires review/trust of the exact command-hook definition before it runs; use Codex CLI /hooks to review it. Stable MCP configuration is separate and uses waitloop mcp.
codex.pluginNote: A Codex plugin can bundle skills/MCP/hooks, but plugin-bundled command hooks still require Codex hook review/trust, so it does not remove the core trust step.

privacy.deviceCredentials: scoped bearer credentials; server stores SHA-256 digest only
privacy.gameActorCredentials: room/actor-scoped; never place in URLs or source control
privacy.localMcpCredentials: stored under private ~/.waitloop state; local MCP returns only safe room metadata and snapshots
privacy.browserActorIdentity: Actor ID is not authorization; the separate anonymous credential is stored in an HttpOnly cookie and only its digest is stored per room
privacy.advisorPrivateView: an advisor sees only the private state of the seat it is explicitly bound to
